summary: [catalog-ui-management] Availability source picker: country-first dialog on the real API (GET only)
description:
### Overview

Current: On movie and TV profiles, the Availability section's Manage sources button (app/src/components/pages/media-profile/AvailabilitySection.jsx) opens SourcePickerDialog with the availabilityDomain stub in components/ui/SourcePickerDialog/domains/stubs.js. The dialog says "Availability sources aren't connected yet."

Desired: connect it to GET /v1/visibility/media-availability-export/media/{media_id}/availability-sources, which MC-1431 shipped and is live on INT. Availability is scoped by country, so the dialog body is country-first:

- the user picks a country;
- the dialog shows what each source lists there (services with logos and offers) and which source is in use.

The trigger and dialog shell stay the same as the other domains. See the attached mockup.

This ticket renders the GET only. Saving is a follow-up, likely a per-country rule.

The original description assumed a different response (a flat availability_entries list and one rule with is_visible) and per-domain files. Both are out of date. The dialog now uses the shared useSourcePicker and domain-config pattern from MC-1646.

### Evidence

The real INT response for Avatar is attached (MC-1435-avatar-availability-sources.json). It shows the data the UI has to handle:

Finding
Detail
Shape
rules (array or null, no is_visible) plus sources[].countries[]. Each country row has level, is_active, a server-computed priority, and distributors[] with offers[]
Coverage
GraceNote: US only. JustWatch: 81 countries. US is the only country with more than one source
In use
US priority: GraceNote 4, JustWatch 5. JustWatch is 3 everywhere else. The existing DEFAULT_ORDER [1, 2, 5] leaves out JustWatch, so it would pick wrong
Offers
51 exact duplicates (11 on JustWatch US Amazon). 56 currencies. GraceNote says "Subscription" with no price; JustWatch says "Flat-rate" at price 0 and adds a "Canvas" quality
Distributors
JP "FOD" has key: null. 5 have no logo (Pathé, meJane, Go3, TV 2)
Logos
GraceNote sends 4:3 transparent wordmarks (360×270 up to 3200×2400 PNG). JustWatch sends 100×100 square icons. A square crop cuts off GraceNote's
Not in this sample
level: "series" rows, is_active false or null, a title rule, and a distributor with no offers. All are possible per the API

### Acceptance Criteria

- Opening Manage sources on a movie or TV profile sends exactly one GET to the endpoint above and shows real data. No fixture data remains in this card's production path.
- Country list: every country in the response, filterable by name or ISO code, with countries that have more than one source listed first.
  - Each row shows how many sources it has, or the name of its single source.
- US is selected by default when present.
- Changing country sends no request.
- Chosen country: one card per source that has data there, using the existing source option card, with each service shown as its own tile (logo, name and offers).
  - The source in use is the one with the lowest priority for that country, and it carries the "In use" badge.
- Offers keep the source's own wording (Buy, Rent, Subscription, Flat rate). Prices use each offer's currency, and price 0 reads "Included".
- Exact duplicate offers are merged. The full per-service offer list is available on expand.
- A country with one source says there's nothing to switch to.
- Logos: every logo has the same frame size. Square icons fill the frame, wider logos show uncropped, and a missing or broken logo falls back to initials. Logos stay legible in dark mode.
- Loading, error (with Try again) and empty (no sources) states show.
- The dialog is read-only: the radios are disabled, there's no Use button, and no POST, PUT or DELETE is sent. Users without visibility.manage see the existing permission note.
- The dialog works at phone width: the country list stacks above the sources.
- The copy and behavior of the genres, companies, ratings, videos and images dialogs are unchanged.
- Tests cover the adapter (including every case in Evidence and the ones not in the sample), the fetch flow (loading, success, error, retry, a late response after close), and the read-only guarantee. Storybook has stories for the new pieces.

### Implementation Notes

- Start from components/ui/SourcePickerDialog/domains/ratings.js, the existing country-scoped domain, plus domains/videos.js and useSourcePicker.js. Add visibility.getAvailabilitySources(mediaId) next to getAssetSources in services/catalog-management/index.js.
- The shared view-model (buildViewModel in sourcePicker.model.js) assumes one in-use source per title, taken from DEFAULT_ORDER. Availability needs one per country, from priority. Extending it or adding a country-keyed model is the implementer's call. The other domains must not change.
- Possible reusable pieces: a service tile, a provider logo with a fallback, and a filterable country list. Create them with /add-component. SourceCountryGroups already has a filter pattern.
- Badge tones: use sourceBadgeTone from MC-1439 (PR #235) so JustWatch gets shadcn-badge-justwatch. If that PR hasn't merged yet, build on it or add the mapping locally.
- Approved token: --logo-plate in styles/themes/light.css and dark.css, a light background that stays light in dark mode so black wordmarks (Apple TV) stay visible. No other theme or token changes.
- Logo URL: use logo.destination.absolute_url, then fall back to logo.source.absolute_url. GraceNote files can be 3200px wide, so use a smaller size from the resizing URL if one is available.

### References

- Mockup (attached): MC-1435-availability-source-picker-mockup.html. Download it and open it in a browser; the toggles switch state, permission, width and theme. A .png is attached too. It shows intent; this ticket and repo conventions win where they differ.
- Real response (attached): MC-1435-avatar-availability-sources.json, Avatar on INT, 2026-11-20.
- API docs: https://int-catalog-svc-management.mta.fand.co/docs#tag/visibility/GET/v1/visibility/media-availability-export/media/{media_id}/availability-sources
- Backend: catalog-svc-management PR #397 and catalog-db-core PR #499 (visibility.media_availability_export_select_sources, which documents how priority is computed)
- Shared source picker pattern: MC-1646. Ratings, country-scoped: MC-1434. Save pattern for the follow-up: MC-1647
- Badge tone helper: MC-1439, PR #235

comments.author: user-1
comments.body:
❌ research-loop - scope too large, needs split

Context: This ticket bundles the data layer, a country-keyed view-model change, several new UI components, a new theme token, the country-first dialog with its states, and the read-only and phone-width behavior. That is about 10 behavior ACs across 12+ files, which is more than a small or medium ticket.

Needs decision:

- Approve the drafted split: Ticket A, the data layer (visibility.getAvailabilitySources, the availability adapter and per-country in-use view-model with every Evidence case, domain fetch/adapt wired in, tests); Ticket B, the UI pieces (logo with initials fallback, service tile, filterable country list, --logo-plate token, stories), which can run in parallel with A; Ticket C, the dialog wiring (country-first body, loading/error/retry/empty, late response after close, read-only and permission note, phone layout), which depends on A and B.
- Decide whether the badge-tone mapping builds on PR #235, which is still open, or is added locally.

GitHub Issue (https://github.com/fandango/catalog-ui-management/issues/236)
